summary: Replay installation permission-denied GitHub reads once with the transition PAT and retain GraphQL error field details

replay.detail: Claim replay is unchanged. Only idempotent GitHub queries and REST reads can use credential fallback; mutations are never replayed.

rules.detail: GitHub read permission failures can fall back to the existing transition PAT. Rate-limit refusals do not trigger permission fallback.

compatibility.detail: PAT fallback responses remain ineligible for installation-principal caches and cannot use installation ETags. GraphQL refusals retain error type and field path.

recovery.detail: No new persistent state or recovery procedure.
